name: r4_source_write_006
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
s=Path('inputs/drafts/URMatchingSource.lean').read_text()
s=s.replace('Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic','Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic')
s=s.replace('end URMatching','''theorem girthAtLeast_mono {G : SimpleGraph V} {g h : ℕ}
    (H : GirthAtLeast G g) (h_le : h ≤ g) : GirthAtLeast G h :=
  fun v p hp => le_trans h_le (H v p hp)

theorem girthAtLeast_iff_no_short_cycle (G : SimpleGraph V) (g : ℕ) :
    GirthAtLeast G g ↔ ¬ ∃ (v : V) (p : G.Walk v v), p.IsCycle ∧ p.length < g := by
  constructor
  · rintro H ⟨v, p, hp, hs⟩
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (H v p hp)) hs
  · intro H v p hp
    exact Nat.le_of_not_lt (fun hs => H ⟨v, p, hp, hs⟩)

end URMatching''')
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingSource.lean'],input=s,text=True);sys.exit(r.returncode)
